description: Deletes the user registration for the given user and application along with the given JSON body that contains the event information. OR Deletes the user registration for the given user and application.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

applicationId.description: The Id of the application to remove the registration for.

eventInfo.description: Information about a user event (login, register, etc) that helps identify the source of the event (location, device type, OS, etc).

location.description: Location information. Useful for IP addresses and other displayable data objects.

userId.description: The Id of the user whose registration is being deleted.

name: deleteUserRegistrationWithId
